# Cross-implementation test vectors

`hub-signing-vectors.json` is copied verbatim from `Relmaur/taw-hub`
(`docs/reference/hub-signing-vectors.json`, generated by its
`scripts/gen-signing-vectors.php` from the real `SignedMessage` / `Ed25519Signer` /
`HmacSha256Signer`). It carries known-good `(canonical, headers, signature, key)` tuples
plus a deliberately-tampered case.

`tests/Unit/Wire/SigningVectorsTest.php` loads it and asserts byte-for-byte parity —
canonical strings, request verification through `SignatureGate`, and the `RESPONSE`
direction.

**Re-copy this file** whenever the Hub regenerates it (which only happens on a
`TAW-HUB-v1` → `v2` canonical change, gated by a new ADR).
